newsitem.title: GHANA: Ghana's Rawlings sworn in for new four-year term.
newsitem.headline: Ghana's Rawlings sworn in for new four-year term.

text.p: President Jerry Rawlings, who has dominated national life in Ghana for almost two decades, was sworn in on Tuesday for a second and final two-year term.

Rawlings, a former air force officer who staged two successful coups, chalked up a historic poll victory last month to become the first incumbent to be re-elected since the West African nation's independence in 1957.

Members of parliament elected in the same December 7 poll were also sworn in at the colourful ceremony. Foreign guests included Nigerian military ruler General Sani Abacha and African American Black Muslim leader Louis Farrakhan.
